ambiguity.rationale: 1 validated seeded benign or contradictory explanations.

preconditions: A web-service process running as its own domain service account selects a member server from a directory query, then presents a different administrative account's credentials (explicit credential use and a service ticket for that account) to open a WinRM session.
The accepted session is a member of the server's local Administrators group and runs an elevated discovery utility inside that session.
A scheduled inventory WinRM session from another workstation under its own account and Remote Management Users membership is a competing routine explanation.
emulation_limitations: How the process obtained the administrative credential is outside the released evidence; no credential theft is asserted.
The directory server only answers queries and issues tickets; techniques are attributed to the host where the acting process or session executed.

All records and outcomes are invented, not live observations or model-quality measurements. source_receipt_sha256 hashes the canonical array of the step's support records, not an external execution receipt.
